description: Convert a structure between formats: cdxml, cdx, mol, molV3, sdf, rxn, rxnV3, smiles, inchi, inchikey, rinchi, cml, mrv, json (mol = V2000 molfile, molV3 = V3000, json = Lone Pair drawing, rinchi = the RInChI of a reaction). A SMILES may carry a CXSMILES stereo block (|&1:1,3|), which is read and written back. Reads ChemDraw CDXML and CDX. `notes` says what the target format cannot keep (for example dative bonds in a V2000 molfile). Refused, with the reason, instead of drawn wrongly: SMILES that cannot be read, aromatic rings that cannot alternate single and double bonds, and atoms with too many bonds (unless `as_written`). Not for images (use draw with format svg or png).

as_written.description: Draw atoms that have too many bonds instead of refusing the structure. Default false.

input.description: The structure as text: SMILES, reaction SMILES (reactants>agents>products), InChI, a molfile, RXN, SD file, CDXML, CML or Marvin text, or a Lone Pair drawing (the JSON from an earlier result, or the SVG text of an earlier figure).

name.description: Set to true when `input` is a compound name (e.g. "aspirin") rather than a structure. The name is sent to PubChem to find the structure; this is the only network call the server makes. Short text that is valid SMILES (such as "CO") is read as SMILES, with a note, and not sent. Default false.

name: convert
title: Convert a structure file
